# [AQUA-S]{.acronym-literal}: Authentication Solution QM {#authentication-solution-quality-model}

::: {.model-intro}
**[AQUA-S]{.acronym-literal}** derives the Security factor and its subfactors, as well as five Usability subfactors, from **[AQUA]{.acronym-literal}-E**. In addition, we identified two solution-specific Usability subfactors and two solution-specific quality factors: Privacy and Applicability. The [**Description**](#solution-table) documents them.
:::
